scenarios.prompt: Create a simple todo application and put it on GitHub.
The tests in this project are failing. Find the bug, fix it, make sure the tests pass, and commit the fix.
Add zod as a dependency with npm, use it to implement validateUser in src/user.js, add a test for it, and commit your work.
Add a CONTRIBUTING.md that explains how to set up and contribute to this project, then open a pull request for it on GitHub.

Start a weekly-report branch in its own git worktree next to this checkout. Reuse this checkout's node_modules there instead of installing again, run the project's report script in the worktree, and commit the generated report on that branch. Remove the worktree when you are done.
Write a small Python command-line tool that converts temperatures between Celsius and Fahrenheit, with unit tests. Initialize a git repository and commit it once the tests pass.
Build a small Flappy Bird style browser game in this folder with a canvas, gravity, flapping and pipes, plus automated tests for the game logic, and commit it.
Create a simple todo application with tests in this folder and commit it.

Our team keeps its shared tooling in a separate checkout at ~/CascadeProjects/team-scripts. Read the release checklist there and mirror the steps it lists into scripts/check.sh in this project, make that script executable, and commit it. Leave the shared checkout exactly as you found it.

Write docs/environment.md describing this machine's local development setup: which Node versions are installed under ~/.nvm, which global npm package the newest of those versions has in its lib/node_modules directory and what version it is, what ~/.zshrc adds to PATH, which skills are available under ~/.agents/skills, and which runner the scheduled workflow under ~/.github/workflows asks for. Commit it.

WORKTREE.md names a checkout of the audit/logs branch beside this project. Read the note in that checkout, write what it says into docs/branch-audit.md on main, remove the worktree, and commit the summary. Do not change the audit/logs branch.

A colleague left a reproduction of a bug in a scratch checkout outside this project; REPRO.md names its path. Run that reproduction's test, port its failing case into this project's tests, fix the bug so those tests pass, and commit. Leave every file in the reproduction untouched.
